title: StoneX Global Macro Director: French Bond Market Contagion & BTC Market Outlook | Vincent Deluard
summary: Bitcoin Magazine StoneX Global Macro Director: French Bond Market Contagion & BTC Market Outlook | Vincent Deluard Treasury yields and oil surge as StoneX's Vincent Deluard warns equities are next.
